title: HOKA Val d'Aran by UTMB 2026 — sixth-edition race report and race cards
publisher: HOKA Val d'Aran by UTMB / UTMB World Series
claims: The 2026 edition was the sixth edition, with 6,935 participants from 91 nationalities across eight race formats.
The 2026 VDA marked the return of the original 163 km / 10,000 m+ course after three years in which weather conditions prevented it from taking place; Santos Gabriel Rueda won in 21:32:05.
The 2026 CDH was 110 km, started in Les at 06:00 with 1,301 runners, and was won by Gautier Bonnecarrere in 12:08:55.
The 2026 PDA was 55 km / 3,300 m+, started in Salardú at 07:00 with 1,737 runners, and was won by Luca del Pero in 5:23:25.
The 2026 TDL debuted as a 75 km race with 733 runners; Adrien Jacques and Gemma Arenas were its first winners.
The 2026 EXP was 32 km, started in Vielha at 08:00 with 1,151 participants, and was won by Joel Santamaría in 2:58:43.
The 2026 SKY was 18 km / 900 m+ on a new course, started at Pla de Beret at 10:00 with 969 runners, and was won by Jan Torrella in 1:20:16.
The 2026 Vielha 10K had 600 participants; the race report gives 600 m of gain while the event home page gives 500 m.

The 2026 event home page race cards give VDA 163 km / 10,000 m+, CDH 110 km / 6,400 m+, TDL 75 km / 5,100 m+, PDA 55 km / 3,300 m+, EXP 32 km / 2,100 m+, SKY 18 km / 900 m+ and Vielha 10K 10 km / 500 m+.
